cases.prompt: Use pdf for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Preserve selectable text, vector math, image provenance, stable metadata, and a verified rendering pipeline.
Check page geometry, annotations, embedded fonts, text extraction, overflow, and opening in available viewers.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use pdf with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use pdf with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Use layered covers and readable content panels; keep a white print view where appropriate.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.
